task: Implement ONLY the small request-triggered control plane needed for ChatGPT to invoke the already-canonical V3 checkpoint workflows without the GitHub UI. Base on current main. Add a push-triggered, allowlisted request dispatcher using a dedicated control branch/path contract that accepts strict JSON operations for (1) the existing workflow 'V3 application immutable release' with exact inputs source_sha, schema_compatibility, compatibility_evidence, reviewed_compatible_migration_sets, rollback_eligible and (2) the existing workflow 'V3 application live-checkpoint deploy' with exact inputs deployment_mode and release_run_id. The dispatcher must validate keys/types/values fail-closed, pin ref=main, use the GitHub Actions API with the workflow GITHUB_TOKEN and only the minimum permissions required, print only sanitized request/run correlation evidence, and never duplicate or weaken the canonical release/deploy logic. Add focused unit/contract tests and a short operations note. Do not alter target-authority.json, production, Contabo host state, release/deploy semantics, secrets, database, DNS, or application code. Push a new isolated branch and seal normally.
